comment:
* This represents a primitive or constructed data defined by ASN.1. A constructed node can have
 * child nodes. A non-constructed node can have a value. This class is read-only. To build a node,
 * you can use the {@link #newBuilder(int)} method to get a {@link Builder} instance. This class is
 * not thread-safe.

variables.name: mChildren
variables.comment: methods (e.g., toBytes()), but always use getChildren() instead.

variables.name: mDataBytes
variables.comment: of its children, which will be decoded on the first call to getChildren().

variables.name: mDataOffset
variables.comment: Offset of the data in above byte array.

variables.name: mEncodedLength
variables.comment: Length of the total bytes required to encode this node.

methods.name: public static Builder newBuilder(int tag)
methods.comment:
* Creates a new ASN.1 data node builder with the given tag. The tag is an encoded tag including
     * the tag class, tag number, and constructed mask.

methods.name: public boolean hasChild(int tag, int... tags) throws InvalidAsn1DataException
methods.comment:
* Tests if a node has a child.
     *
     * @param tag The tag of an immediate child.
     * @param tags The tags of lineal descendant.

methods.name: public Asn1Node getChild(int tag, int... tags) throws TagNotFoundException, InvalidAsn1DataException
methods.comment:
* Gets the first child node having the given {@code tag} and {@code tags}.
     *
     * @param tag The tag of an immediate child.
     * @param tags The tags of lineal descendant.
     * @throws TagNotFoundException If the child cannot be found.

methods.name: public List<Asn1Node> getChildren(int tag) throws TagNotFoundException, InvalidAsn1DataException
methods.comment:
* Gets all child nodes which have the given {@code tag}.
     *
     * @return If this is primitive or no such children are found, an empty list will be returned.

methods.name: public List<Asn1Node> getChildren() throws InvalidAsn1DataException
methods.comment:
* Gets all child nodes of this node. If it's a constructed node having encoded data, it's
     * children will be decoded here.
     *
     * @return If this is primitive, an empty list will be returned. Do not modify the returned list
     *     directly.

methods.name: public boolean hasValue()
methods.comment: @return Whether this node has a value. False will be returned for a constructed node.

methods.name: public int asInteger() throws InvalidAsn1DataException
methods.comment:
* @return The data as an integer. If the data length is larger than 4, only the first 4 bytes
     *     will be parsed.
     * @throws InvalidAsn1DataException If the data bytes cannot be parsed.

methods.name: public long asRawLong() throws InvalidAsn1DataException
methods.comment:
* @return The data as a long variable which can be both positive and negative. If the data
     *     length is larger than 8, only the first 8 bytes will be parsed.
     * @throws InvalidAsn1DataException If the data bytes cannot be parsed.

methods.name: public String asString() throws InvalidAsn1DataException
methods.comment:
* @return The data as a string in UTF-8 encoding.
     * @throws InvalidAsn1DataException If the data bytes cannot be parsed.

methods.name: public byte[] asBytes() throws InvalidAsn1DataException
methods.comment:
* @return The data as a byte array.
     * @throws InvalidAsn1DataException If the data bytes cannot be parsed.

methods.name: public int asBits() throws InvalidAsn1DataException
methods.comment:
* Gets the data as an integer for BIT STRING. DER actually stores the bits in a reversed order.
     * The returned integer here has the order fixed (first bit is at the lowest position). This
     * method currently only support at most 32 bits which fit in an integer.
     *
     * @return The data as an integer. If this is constructed, a {@code null} will be returned.
     * @throws InvalidAsn1DataException If the data bytes cannot be parsed.

methods.name: public boolean asBoolean() throws InvalidAsn1DataException
methods.comment:
* @return The data as a boolean.
     * @throws InvalidAsn1DataException If the data bytes cannot be parsed.

methods.name: public int getEncodedLength()
methods.comment: @return The number of required bytes for encoding this node in DER.

methods.name: public int getDataLength()
methods.comment: @return The number of required bytes for encoding this node's data in DER.

methods.name: public void writeToBytes(byte[] dest, int offset)
methods.comment:
* Writes the DER encoded bytes of this node into a byte array. The number of written bytes is
     * {@link #getEncodedLength()}.
     *
     * @throws IndexOutOfBoundsException If the {@code dest} doesn't have enough space to write.

methods.name: public byte[] toBytes()
methods.comment: Writes the DER encoded bytes of this node into a new byte array.

methods.name: public String toHex()
methods.comment: Gets a hex string representing the DER encoded bytes of this node.

methods.name: public String getHeadAsHex()
methods.comment: Gets header (tag + length) as hex string.

methods.name: private int write(byte[] dest, int offset)
methods.comment: Returns the new offset where to write the next node data.
